decision: fix(oracle): replace require(vectordb) with dynamic import — ESM-safe
key_insight: fix(oracle): replace require(vectordb) with dynamic import — ESM-safe
outcome:
## Problem

`modules/oracle/adapters/lance-db.ts` mixed ESM and CJS syntax:

```ts
import path from "path"           // ESM — marks the file as ES Module
const lancedb = require("vectordb") // CJS — require() doesn't exist in ESM
```

When Node sees `import` at the top, it treats the whole file as an ES Module. In ESM scope, `require` is not defined. Any consumer calling `setup()` (which wires the full Oracle with LanceDB) hits:

```
ReferenceError: require is not defined in ES module scope
```
